item.title: Steris Corporation: VERIFY Dual Species Self-Contained Biological Indicator Model/Catalog Number: S3061 Recall
item.product: VERIFY Dual Species Self-Contained Biological Indicator Model/Catalog Number: S3061
item.summary: Geobacillus stearothermophilus spore population in affected products may fall below minimum shelf life specification. When used to monitor steam sterilization cycles, the potential hazard is that the biological indicator will show no growth, indicating that the steam cycle was effective, even if the steam cycle did not achieve the intended spore reduction Product details: VERIFY Dual Species Self-Contained Biological Indicator Model/Catalog Number: S3061
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
